# Fel Empire

#REDIRECT Galactic Empire
The Fel Empire was a sort of sequel to the Galactic Empire from Star Wars, appearing around the Legacy comic books Era, only to be turned by the one Sith, Darth Krayt, into part of his Sith Empire. Located in the outer rim territories, this hereditary monarchy-based government was built on the imperial remnants that the new republic spent most of its existence fighting.
key characters loyal to the Fel Empire
The key characters of the Fel Empire are as follows:
* Jagged Fel: founder of the Fel Empire and its main dynasty, the Fel dynasty, creating it as an appropriation of a movement stemming from the Separatist from the clone wars like secession movement stemming from the Yuuzhan Vong War, which created the galactic alliance
* Jaina Solo Organa Fel: one of the two firstborn children of Leia Organa and Han Solo, and the wife of Jagged Fel, who was also key to creating the imperial knights, the Fel empire's version of the (new) Jedi Order
* Roan Fel: grandson of Jagged and Jaina, third emperor of the Fel Empire, helped lead the empire after its exile (over it being conquered by Darth Krayt)
* Marasiah Fel: daughter of Roan and later on fourth empress of the Fel Empire
vehicles of the Fel Empire
main vehicles
The two main vehicles of the Fel Empire are the Predator-class starfighters and the MASSIVE (and massive-looking from photos) Pellaeon-class star destroyer
